pricesCannabisSpendPerResidentMinor.estimatedFrom: Those state sales over each state's residents (Michigan about $300, Illinois about $160, Massachusetts about $240, Colorado about $240, California about $120 a year) and the national total over the residents of the states with legal retail sales, about $170.

spread.citation: Per-resident 2024 sales of California (about $120) to Michigan (about $300).

pricesChangeImpulseScale.citation: How hard a change to a household's monthly bill lands on a person's mood and stress, per share of the household's monthly earnings it moved (a bill 10% of earnings smaller lands as a mood impulse of 0.1). The same scale the benefit engine uses for a changed award (benefitChangeImpulseScale), checked against the life-event impulses the drives engine reads.

spread.unit: impulse per share of monthly earnings
spread.citation: Half to twice the benefit engine's scale.
